description: List Sui DeepBook v3 spot pools with base/quote assets and trading params (tick, lot, min size in human units). Optional filter by asset symbol. Education/information only; not financial advice. Read-only public data, may be delayed or wrong. Free: 100 calls/day per client, then 0.002 USDC per call on Sui mainnet, prepaid in batches of about 0.01 USDC (the payment-required response gives an exact amount and a payment_token).

asset.description: Only pools containing this asset symbol, e.g. SUI or USDC

include_ids.description: Include pool object IDs and coin types (longer output)

payment_token.description: Only after the free tier: the private payment_token from the payment-required response; it holds your prepaid calls

payment_tx.description: Only after the free tier: Sui transaction digest of your exact USDC payment for payment_token (see the payment-required response)
